channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Lebanon says 12 killed in Israeli strikes on southern town
item.description: Israeli strikes killed 12 people in southern Lebanon, despite a ceasefire and evacuation warnings. Lebanon said Israeli strikes killed 12 people in the south, including in a town under an evacuation warning despite a ceasefire.

item.title: China’s UN envoy blasts US ‘bullying’ as sanctions widen before Trump-Xi talks
item.description: China's UN envoy criticized US sanctions as bullying before Trump-Xi talks. China’s UN envoy blasts US ‘bullying’ as sanctions widen before Trump-Xi talks South China Morning Post.

item.title: At least 12 killed in latest Israeli attacks on Lebanon
item.description: Israeli attacks on Lebanon killed at least 12, with over 2,600 dead since March 2. Israel's strikes continue, with more than 2,600 killed since March 2, despite an ongoing ceasefire.

item.title: Trump tells Congress ceasefire means he does not need their approval for Iran war
item.description: US President Trump claims congressional approval is no longer needed for a war with Iran, citing a ceasefire as proof hostilities have terminated. He made the statement in a letter to Congress on 10 April 2026.

item.title: Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi hospitalised as health deteriorates
item.description: Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi was hospitalized after losing consciousness twice. Mohammadi has lost consciousness twice and suffered a severe cardiac crisis, her foundation has announced. Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi hospitalised as health deteriorates.

item.title: Trump ‘Not Satisfied’ With Iran’s Proposal on Ending War
item.description: President Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Iran's proposal to end the war. The details of the latest plan were unclear, and President Trump did not specify his objections. Trump ‘Not Satisfied’ With Iran’s Proposal on Ending War.

item.title: A deadline for the Iran war is here. What does the War Powers Act say?
item.description: The War Powers Act deadline for the Iran war is here. The act requires presidential reporting. A deadline for the Iran war is here. What does the War Powers Act say?

item.title: Trump says 'not satisfied' with new Iran proposal sent through Pakistan
item.description: The US administration has declared its war in Iran terminated, 60 days before a deadline to seek congressional approval. The decision comes after a ceasefire was brokered in the region.

item.title: US judge bars Trump from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals
item.description: A US judge has blocked the Trump administration from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals, part of a broader immigration crackdown. The administration had sought to cancel temporary protections for 13 countries.

item.title: U.S. Indictment of Sinaloa’s Governor Is a Reckoning for Residents of the Mexican State
item.description: The US indicted Sinaloa's governor for organized crime ties. The U. S. indictment of a Mexican governor confirms what many residents say they had long suspected: The line between organized crime and the upper echelons of government has blurred.

item.title: Israel Said to Have Helped Defend Emirates in Iran War With Iron Dome
item.description: Israel reportedly helped defend the UAE with its Iron Dome missile defense system during the Iran war. The Emirates bore the brunt of Iran's retaliatory attacks on Gulf countries. It appeared to be the first time the missile defense system was sent to an Arab country.

item.title: Gas prices hit $4.39 per gallon in biggest one-day jump since Iran ceasefire announced
item.description: Gas prices jumped to $4.39 per gallon after the Iran ceasefire. Gas prices hit $4.39 per gallon in biggest one-day jump since Iran ceasefire announced NBC News.

item.title: Can Iran withstand the US naval blockade?
item.description: The US has imposed a naval blockade on Iran to cut off its oil exports. The Trump administration aims to force Iran into concessions through economic pressure. The Trump administration is trying to force Iran into concessions by cutting off its oil exports.

item.title: China and America Are Courting Nuclear Catastrophe
item.description: China and the US are increasing their nuclear arsenals and tensions. China and America Are Courting Nuclear Catastrophe Foreign Affairs.

item.title: China Says UN Should Revisit Lebanon Peacekeeping Mission Decision
item.description: China wants the UN to revisit its Lebanon peacekeeping mission decision. China Says UN Should Revisit Lebanon Peacekeeping Mission Decision U. S. News & World Report.

item.title: "Why Would I Tell You That?" Trump Evades Reporter's Question On Iran Strikes
item.description: Trump evaded a reporter's question on potential Iran strikes. Iran has maintained its stranglehold on the Strait of Hormuz, cutting off vast amounts of oil. "Why Would I Tell You That?" Trump Evades Reporter's Question On Iran Strikes.

item.title: US Military-Run Mission For Gaza Aid Set To Close Soon: Report
item.description: US officials described the upcoming closure of the US military-run Gaza aid mission as an overhaul. US officials have privately described the move as an overhaul. US Military-Run Mission For Gaza Aid Set To Close Soon: Report.

item.title: US Warns Shippers Against Paying Hormuz Toll, Threatens Sanctions Risks
item.description: The US warned shippers against paying tolls to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. Shippers face sanctions risks if they comply with the toll demands. The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most strategically vital maritime routes.

item.title: U.S.'s Hormuz coalition 'not in competition' with France, U.K.-led bid: French FM
item.description: France's foreign minister stated that the US-led Hormuz coalition isn't competing with a UK-France-led maritime effort. Over 50 countries attended a meeting on the separate initiative. The U. K. and France have led talks on a separate maritime effort, recently holding a meeting with more than 50 countries.

item.title: Rebels take key military camp in Mali's north
item.description: Rebel forces captured a key military camp in Mali's north without encountering clashes. The camp in Tessalit was taken from government forces. A security source in Gao, south of Tessalit, said "no clashes took place" during the rebel forces' capture of Tessalit.
